mentions.name: Ferdig
mentions.description: A fully offline-capable todo app with AI integration at its core, built to keep up with home renovation tasks.
mentions.problem: Existing todo apps are annoying to use and lack good AI integration; the author needed one to track home renovation tasks.
mentions.source_excerpt:
So I started vibe coding my own app. Fully offline capable and with ai integration at its core.

I run it at https://ferdig.de
